settings.editor: Every floor is priced on the room, not a rate card. These are the things that move the number up or down, and the reason we measure in person before quoting.
Larger open runs cost less per square foot than several small rooms, closets and hallways.
Red oak sits at the affordable end. White oak, hickory and wide-plank cost more per square foot.
A flat, dry, sound subfloor installs straight through. Levelling or moisture issues add labor.
Stair treads, risers, borders and inlays are priced per piece, because they are slow, skilled work.
Included as standard. Tile or glued-down flooring takes longer to remove than carpet.
Prefinished goes down faster. Site-finished costs more and gives a seamless surface.

tabs.tab_title: How long does hardwood installation take?
tabs.tab_content: Most OKC homes are finished in three to five days from the day we start, depending on square footage and whether the subfloor needs work. We give you a firm schedule with your written quote.

tabs.tab_title: Do I need to move my furniture?
tabs.tab_content: No. Moving your furniture is included in the quote. The exceptions are pianos, safes and anything that needs a specialist. Tell us during the estimate and we will sort out a plan.

tabs.tab_title: Solid or engineered: which is right for me?
tabs.tab_content: Solid hardwood can be refinished more times and suits most above-grade rooms. Engineered handles moisture and slab subfloors better, which matters in basements and over concrete. We will look at your subfloor and tell you honestly which one fits.

tabs.tab_title: Can you install over my existing floor?
tabs.tab_content: Sometimes. Engineered floors can often go over a sound, flat existing floor, which saves removal cost. Over old tile or a floor with movement, it is usually a false economy. We check during the free estimate and tell you either way.

tabs.tab_title: How much does it cost per square foot?
tabs.tab_content: It depends on species, grade, subfloor condition and detail work, so an honest number needs a look at the space. The in-home estimate is free and you get the price in writing before anything starts.
Yes, licensed and insured, with OKC-based crews. We are happy to show you the paperwork.
